# Open Weight Models

Independent reference for open-weight AI models, licenses, hardware and deployment.
All model pages are full Model Passports verified on 2026-09-29.

## Structured data
- Registry JSON: https://openweightmodels.eu/data/models.json
- Sitemap: https://openweightmodels.eu/sitemap.xml

## Methodology note
OpenWeightModels separates base-model facts, license rights and deployment-specific facts. Official model cards and license texts are preferred; ambiguous fields are not guessed.
